failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What are the alternate titles or alternate names for Shakespeare's "Twelfth Night"? Is "What You Will" another title for "Twelfth Night"?' - This is a natural-language yes/no question format bundling two related asks (alternate titles generally, then a specific yes/no verification).

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query: 'Is the alternate title "What You Will" for Shakespeare's "Twelfth Night" verified in the provided passages, and what is the status of verification for the film "She's the Man" being inspired by this play?' - This query asks the retrieval system to meta-analyze whether previously retrieved passages verified something, rather than formulating a concrete search target. It bundles a meta-question with a verification-status question.

failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states: 'the provided passages are insufficient to verify the second part of the claim—that this play is also known by the name "What You Will."' and requests a 'Missing evidence document needed: Information about Shakespeare's "Twelfth Night" that would verify whether it has the alternate title "What You Will"'. However, hop 1 passage [5] explicitly states: 'She's the Man is a 2006 American romantic sport-comedy film directed by Andy Fickman...Inspired by William Shakespeare's play "Twelfth Night"', which was available to the solver at summary_1 and establishes the film-play connection. The solver claimed this information was missing when it was present.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query asks 'What are the alternate titles or alternate names for Shakespeare's "Twelfth Night"? Is "What You Will" another title for "Twelfth Night"?' After hop 2 successfully retrieves multiple passages confirming the alternate title (passages about 'Twelfth Night, or What You Will'), hop 3 query re-asks essentially the same question: 'Is the alternate title "What You Will" for Shakespeare's "Twelfth Night" verified in the provided passages...' The query fails to advance beyond what hop 2 already established, re-asking about the same alternate-title verification.
